svg.title: Headroom vs the harness
svg.desc: Headroom sits on the wire and rewrites transcript history every request, compressing tool output lossily. straitjacket captures at the source into an addressable store and puts a bounded digest on the wire.
svg.text: measured 2026-07-19: Headroom 357 tok, needle DROPPED · ctx ~520 tok, needle SURVIVED with address
